chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Messenger of Allah's Messenger (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Whoever wakes up in the morning not thinking of being unjust to anyone, Allah will forgive whatever sins he commits.'
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of waking up without intending to oppress others?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi, this hadith links the morning state of mind to divine mercy, reflecting the Shia emphasis on internalizing justice before acting upon it. It suggests that freedom from the intent to oppress is a key condition for the forgiveness of past transgressions, highlighting the spiritual weight of intention (niyyah) in daily life.
